run_reference: Model-visible final run intent_sha256 is current final intent; solution_sha256 is selected dev code. No extra response fields or seventh tool.
no_new_scope: This clarifies already-approved dev-only selection/final-refit provenance; no new scientific endpoint/budget or native authority.
